outcome.decision: Candidate rejected as a latency fix; patch retained only as an unapplied experiment artifact.
outcome.latencyClaim: No editor-latency fix demonstrated. Cold and post-edit requests remain multi-second; warm sub-millisecond results are not evidence of improved edit responsiveness.

pnpm.launchNote: setup-observations.json records the literal pnpm shim setup: initial `corepack pnpm@11.8.0 build:packages` failed because the internal build script could not invoke literal pnpm; Corepack shims supplied on PATH allowed `pnpm build:packages` to pass without source changes.

hardware.provenance: setup-observations.json host fields record macOS 15.7 build 24G222, MacBookPro18,2, arm64, 68719476736 bytes of memory and 10 CPUs; native reports independently record darwin/arm64.

upstream.forkPurpose: External issue-1737 demand-boundary probe fork adding root-hover only; original modes, compiler identities, memory guard behavior, request limits, and disk/source guards are retained.

hashing.canonicalJson: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted object keys; no whitespace separators; non-ASCII retained (Python json.dumps sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False). Arrays retain their order.
hashing.sourceInventoryDigest: Canonical hash of raw sourceHashesBefore/sourceHashesAfter object. Full inventories remain in raw reports.
hashing.parametersSha256: Canonical hash of ordered label/method/params triples, including the actual initialize processId.
hashing.normalizedWorkloadSha256: Canonical hash of normalizedWorkload stored for each mode. Remove only initialize.params.processId and documents[].elapsedMs; retain exact request order, parameters, document text, version, hashes and edit ranges.
hashing.completedLatencyMs: Raw measurement.latencyMs only for Resolved requests.
hashing.pendingElapsedUntilRejectionMs: Raw measurement.latencyMs for Rejected requests: elapsed until failure, not response latency and not a completed clear.
hashing.resultCanonicalSha256: Canonical JSON hash of actual LSP result, not source type equivalence.
hashing.hoverTextSha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 contents.value as returned, without normalization.

executionOrder.policy: Fresh owned native process for every report, serial requests within each report; all runs serialized.
executionOrder.orderProvenance: run-editor-series.mjs records the mode loop order. The external report filenames and exit JSON files record arm labels and repetitions; reports have elapsed timings but do not embed wall-clock start timestamps.

limitations: One fresh native LSP process and one sequential request flow; this is a bounded reproduction, not a general editor or profiling benchmark.
Memory is sampled with macOS libproc every 250 ms; brief peaks between samples may be missed. The native process is killed above 3 GiB RSS or 4 GiB physical footprint, or after 22 seconds.

Workspace hashes cover readable regular files and symlink targets, including source and dist, excluding every node_modules and .git directory; symlinks are recorded without following them. Compiler/client/launcher/guard hashes are recorded separately, not a full dependency inventory.

Only in-memory didOpen/didChange edits are sent. The output report is the only intended persistent write. The disposable checkout must be idle; hashes detect covered file changes but do not prevent concurrent writers.
The installed wrapper resolves the native executable and supplies its vendored JSON-RPC client. Actual identities are recorded without hardcoded package or profiler pins.
No framework or public API change is retained. The direct import is an unapplied patch artifact, not a proposed latency solution.
Full immutable raw reports, exact executed harness bytes, source inventories and contract reports and logs are archived in evidence.tar.xz. archive-manifest.json records the archived file hashes.
